column2:
parallel(adj./n./v.)平行的、相似處、與……相似
(無詞性變化)
parallel lines 平行線
draw a parallel between 比較……的相似之處
The road runs parallel to the river for several kilometers.
(這條路與河流平行延伸好幾公里。)
The teacher drew a parallel between the two historical events.
(老師比較了這兩個歷史事件的相似之處。)

participant(n.)參與者、參加者
participate(v.)參加
participation(n.)參與
active participant 積極的參與者
participants in ……的參加者
All participants in the contest will receive a certificate.
(所有參賽者都會獲得一張證書。)
She was an active participant in class discussions.
(她在課堂討論中是積極的參與者。)

particle(n.)微粒、粒子、極少量
(無詞性變化)
fine particles 細懸浮微粒
dust particles 灰塵顆粒
Fine particles in the air can cause serious breathing problems.
(空氣中的細懸浮微粒可能造成嚴重的呼吸問題。)
There isn't a particle of truth in what he said.
(他說的話沒有一點是真的。)

partly(adv.)部分地、在某種程度上
part(n.)部分
partial(adj.)部分的、偏袒的
partly cloudy 局部多雲
partly because 部分是因為
It will be partly cloudy with a chance of rain this afternoon.
(今天下午局部多雲，可能會下雨。)
I failed the test partly because I didn't sleep well.
(我考試沒過，部分是因為我沒睡好。)

passionate(adj.)熱情的、熱愛的、激昂的
passion(n.)熱情、熱愛
passionately(adv.)熱情地
be passionate about 熱愛……
passionate speech 慷慨激昂的演說
She is passionate about protecting endangered animals.
(她熱衷於保護瀕危動物。)
The student gave a passionate speech about climate change.
(那位學生針對氣候變遷發表了一場慷慨激昂的演說。)

pastry(n.)糕點、酥皮點心
(無詞性變化)
pastry chef 糕點師傅
puff pastry 千層酥皮
The bakery sells delicious French pastries every morning.
(那家麵包店每天早上販賣美味的法式糕點。)
My cousin is training to become a pastry chef in Paris.
(我表姊正在巴黎受訓成為糕點師傅。)

patch(n./v.)補丁、小塊區域、修補
patchy(adj.)零散的、不均勻的
patch up 修補、和解
vegetable patch 小菜園
My grandmother sewed a patch on the knee of my jeans.
(我奶奶在我的牛仔褲膝蓋處縫了一塊補丁。)
The two friends finally patched up their quarrel.
(那兩個朋友終於和好了。)

patent(n./adj./v.)專利、專利的、取得專利
(無詞性變化)
apply for a patent 申請專利
patent law 專利法
The engineer applied for a patent on his new invention.
(那位工程師為他的新發明申請專利。)
The company patented its design to stop others from copying it.
(那家公司為設計申請專利，以防止他人抄襲。)

pathetic(adj.)可憐的、可悲的、差勁的
pathetically(adv.)可憐地、差勁地
pathetic excuse 拙劣的藉口
pathetic sight 可憐的景象
The lost puppy shivering in the rain was a pathetic sight.
(那隻在雨中發抖的迷路小狗是一幅可憐的景象。)
Saying the dog ate your homework is a pathetic excuse.
(說狗吃了你的作業是個拙劣的藉口。)

patrol(n./v.)巡邏、巡邏隊
(無詞性變化)
on patrol 巡邏中
police patrol 警察巡邏
Police officers patrol the night market every evening.
(警察每天晚上在夜市巡邏。)
The coast guard sent a boat on patrol near the island.
(海巡署派出一艘船在島嶼附近巡邏。)

patron(n.)贊助者、資助人、老主顧
patronage(n.)贊助、光顧
patronize(v.)光顧、以高人一等的態度對待
patron of the arts 藝術贊助者
regular patron 老主顧
The wealthy businessman is a well-known patron of the arts.
(那位富商是知名的藝術贊助者。)
The café offers discounts to its regular patrons.
(這家咖啡店給老主顧打折。)

peasant(n.)農民、佃農
(無詞性變化)
peasant farmer 小農
peasant uprising 農民起義
In the past, most peasants worked on land owned by rich landlords.
(過去大多數農民在富有地主擁有的土地上耕作。)
The peasant uprising changed the history of the country.
(那場農民起義改變了這個國家的歷史。)

pedal(n./v.)踏板、踩踏板
(無詞性變化)
gas pedal 油門
pedal a bike 騎腳踏車
He stepped on the gas pedal when the light turned green.
(綠燈亮時他踩下油門。)
She pedaled hard to climb the steep hill.
(她用力踩踏板爬上陡坡。)

pedestrian(n./adj.)行人、行人的、平淡無奇的
(無詞性變化)
pedestrian crossing 行人穿越道
pedestrian zone 行人徒步區
Drivers must stop for pedestrians at the crossing.
(駕駛必須在行人穿越道前停車讓行人。)
The old street has become a pedestrian zone on weekends.
(這條老街週末成為行人徒步區。)

penetrate(v.)穿透、滲入、看穿
penetration(n.)穿透、滲透
penetrating(adj.)銳利的、有洞察力的
penetrate the skin 穿透皮膚
penetrate the market 打入市場
Sunlight could barely penetrate the thick forest.
(陽光幾乎無法穿透茂密的森林。)
The company is trying to penetrate the Japanese market.
(那家公司正試圖打入日本市場。)

pension(n./v.)退休金、養老金
pensioner(n.)領退休金者
pension plan 退休金計畫
retire on a pension 領退休金退休
My grandfather lives on his pension after retiring from teaching.
(我爺爺從教職退休後靠退休金生活。)
The government is planning to reform the pension system.
(政府正在計劃改革年金制度。)

perceive(v.)察覺、感知、認為
perception(n.)感知、看法
perceptive(adj.)有洞察力的
perceive as 視為……
perceive a change 察覺變化
Many people perceive the Internet as a source of reliable information.
(許多人把網路視為可靠的資訊來源。)
Dogs can perceive sounds that humans cannot hear.
(狗能察覺人類聽不到的聲音。)

perception(n.)感知、看法、認知
perceive(v.)察覺、認為
perceptive(adj.)有洞察力的
public perception 大眾觀感
change one's perception 改變某人的看法
Traveling abroad changed my perception of different cultures.
(出國旅行改變了我對不同文化的看法。)
Public perception of the new policy has been mostly positive.
(大眾對新政策的觀感大致正面。)

performer(n.)表演者、演出者
perform(v.)表演、執行
performance(n.)表演、表現
street performer 街頭藝人
talented performer 有才華的表演者
A street performer was playing the violin outside the station.
(一名街頭藝人在車站外拉小提琴。)
She is one of the most talented performers in the musical.
(她是這部音樂劇中最有才華的演員之一。)

persist(v.)堅持、持續存在
persistence(n.)堅持、毅力
persistent(adj.)堅持不懈的、持續的
persist in 堅持……
problem persists 問題持續存在
If the pain persists, you should see a doctor.
(如果疼痛持續，你應該去看醫生。)
He persisted in practicing the piano every day and finally won the contest.
(他堅持每天練琴，最後贏得了比賽。)

personnel(n.)全體人員、人事部門
(無詞性變化)
medical personnel 醫護人員
personnel department 人事部門
Only authorized personnel are allowed to enter this area.
(只有經授權的人員才可進入此區域。)
Medical personnel worked day and night during the outbreak.
(疫情爆發期間，醫護人員日以繼夜地工作。)

perspective(n./adj.)觀點、看法、透視法
(無詞性變化)
from a different perspective 從不同觀點
put things in perspective 正確看待事情
Try to look at the problem from a different perspective.
(試著從不同的角度看這個問題。)
Talking with my grandmother helped me put things in perspective.
(和奶奶聊天幫助我更客觀地看待事情。)

pessimism(n.)悲觀、悲觀主義
pessimist(n.)悲觀者
pessimistic(adj.)悲觀的
deep pessimism 極度悲觀
pessimism about 對……的悲觀
There is growing pessimism about the future of the economy.
(人們對經濟前景越來越悲觀。)
Her pessimism made it hard for her to try new things.
(她的悲觀讓她很難嘗試新事物。)

petition(n.)請願書、請願
(無詞性變化)
sign a petition 在請願書上簽名
online petition 線上請願
Over ten thousand people signed the petition to save the old tree.
(超過一萬人在請願書上簽名，要求保留那棵老樹。)
Students started an online petition for a longer lunch break.
(學生發起線上請願，爭取更長的午休時間。)

petty(adj.)瑣碎的、小氣的、心胸狹窄的
pettiness(n.)瑣碎、小氣
petty crime 輕微犯罪
petty argument 雞毛蒜皮的爭吵
Don't waste your time on petty arguments with your classmates.
(不要把時間浪費在與同學雞毛蒜皮的爭吵上。)
Petty crimes such as pickpocketing are common in tourist areas.
(扒竊之類的輕微犯罪在觀光區很常見。)

phase(n./v.)階段、時期、分階段進行
(無詞性變化)
final phase 最後階段
phase out 逐步淘汰
The project is now in its final phase.
(這項計畫目前處於最後階段。)
The government plans to phase out plastic straws by 2030.
(政府計劃在二〇三〇年前逐步淘汰塑膠吸管。)

photographic(adj.)攝影的、照片的
photograph(n./v.)照片、拍照
photography(n.)攝影
photographic memory 過目不忘的記憶力
photographic equipment 攝影器材
She has a photographic memory and remembers every page she reads.
(她過目不忘，讀過的每一頁都記得。)
The store sells all kinds of photographic equipment.
(這家店販售各式攝影器材。)

pickup(n.)接送、取貨、小貨車
pick up(v.)撿起、接送
pickup truck 小貨車
pickup point 取貨點、接送點
My uncle drives a pickup truck to carry fruit to the market.
(我叔叔開小貨車載水果到市場。)
Please wait at the pickup point near the hotel entrance.
(請在飯店入口附近的接送點等候。)

pier(n.)碼頭、突堤
(無詞性變化)
fishing pier 釣魚碼頭
walk along the pier 沿著碼頭散步
We walked along the pier and watched the sunset over the sea.
(我們沿著碼頭散步，欣賞海上的夕陽。)
The ferry leaves from Pier 3 every hour.
(渡輪每小時從三號碼頭出發。)

pillar(n.)柱子、支柱、中堅
(無詞性變化)
stone pillar 石柱
pillar of society 社會中堅
The temple roof is supported by carved stone pillars.
(廟宇的屋頂由雕刻的石柱支撐。)
Tourism has become a pillar of the island's economy.
(觀光業已成為這座島嶼經濟的支柱。)

pipeline(n.)管線、輸送管、管道
pipe(n.)管子
oil pipeline 輸油管
in the pipeline 在籌備中
An oil pipeline runs across the desert for hundreds of kilometers.
(一條輸油管橫越沙漠綿延數百公里。)
Several new projects are in the pipeline for next year.
(有好幾項新計畫正在為明年籌備中。)

pirate(n./v.)海盜、盜版者、盜版
piracy(n.)海盜行為、盜版
pirate ship 海盜船
pirated software 盜版軟體
The movie tells the story of a pirate searching for treasure.
(這部電影講述一個海盜尋寶的故事。)
Using pirated software is illegal and can harm your computer.
(使用盜版軟體是違法的，而且可能損害你的電腦。)

pitcher(n.)投手、水壺
pitch(v./n.)投擲、音調
starting pitcher 先發投手
a pitcher of water 一壺水
The starting pitcher struck out ten batters in the game.
(先發投手在比賽中三振了十名打者。)
The waiter brought a pitcher of iced water to our table.
(服務生端了一壺冰水到我們桌上。)

placement(n.)安置、放置、分班
place(n./v.)地方、放置
placement test 分級測驗
job placement 職業安置
All new students must take an English placement test.
(所有新生都必須參加英文分級測驗。)
The careful placement of furniture made the small room look bigger.
(精心擺放的家具讓小房間看起來更大。)

plea(n.)懇求、請求、答辯
plead(v.)懇求、辯護
make a plea for 呼籲、懇求
guilty plea 認罪答辯
The mayor made a plea for people to save water.
(市長呼籲民眾節約用水。)
Despite her desperate plea, the teacher did not change the grade.
(儘管她苦苦懇求，老師並沒有更改成績。)

plead(v.)懇求、辯護、承認(有罪或無罪)
plea(n.)懇求、答辯
plead with 懇求
plead guilty 認罪
The boy pleaded with his parents to let him keep the puppy.
(男孩懇求父母讓他養那隻小狗。)
The man pleaded guilty to stealing the car.
(那名男子承認偷了那輛車。)

pledge(n./v.)誓言、保證、承諾
(無詞性變化)
make a pledge 立誓
pledge support 承諾支持
The company pledged to cut its carbon emissions by half.
(那家公司承諾將碳排放減半。)
Students made a pledge to keep the campus clean.
(學生們立誓維護校園整潔。)

plunge(n./v.)跳入、驟降、陷入
(無詞性變化)
take the plunge 毅然決定
plunge into 跳入、陷入
Stock prices plunged after the bad news was announced.
(壞消息公布後股價暴跌。)
After years of thinking about it, he finally took the plunge and started his own business.
(考慮多年後，他終於毅然決定自己創業。)

plural(adj./n.)複數的、複數
singular(adj./n.)單數的、單數
plural form 複數形
plural noun 複數名詞
The plural form of 'child' is 'children'.
('child' 的複數形是 'children'。)
Remember to use a plural verb with a plural subject.
(記得複數主詞要搭配複數動詞。)

poetic(adj.)詩的、詩意的、富有詩意的
poet(n.)詩人
poetry(n.)詩、詩集
poetic language 詩意的語言
poetic justice 惡有惡報、天理昭彰
The writer describes the mountains in beautiful poetic language.
(作者用優美而富有詩意的語言描寫群山。)
It was poetic justice when the bully slipped on his own banana peel.
(那個惡霸踩到自己丟的香蕉皮滑倒，真是惡有惡報。)

poke(v./n.)戳、捅、刺
(無詞性變化)
poke fun at 取笑
poke one's nose into 干涉、多管閒事
He poked me in the arm to wake me up in class.
(他在課堂上戳我的手臂把我叫醒。)
It's not nice to poke fun at other people's accents.
(取笑別人的口音是不好的。)

porch(n.)門廊、走廊
(無詞性變化)
front porch 前門廊
sit on the porch 坐在門廊上
My grandparents like to sit on the front porch in the evening.
(我爺爺奶奶喜歡傍晚坐在前門廊上。)
The delivery man left the package on our porch.
(送貨員把包裹放在我們家門廊上。)

portfolio(n.)作品集、文件夾、投資組合
(無詞性變化)
learning portfolio 學習歷程檔案
investment portfolio 投資組合
Senior high students in Taiwan need to prepare a learning portfolio for college applications.
(台灣高中生需要為大學申請準備學習歷程檔案。)
The designer showed her portfolio during the job interview.
(那位設計師在求職面試時展示了她的作品集。)

practitioner(n.)從業人員、開業者(醫生、律師等)
practice(n./v.)實踐、執業、練習
general practitioner 一般科醫師、家庭醫師
medical practitioner 醫療從業人員
You should see a general practitioner if your cough continues.
(如果你持續咳嗽，應該去看家庭醫師。)
Traditional Chinese medicine practitioners often use herbs to treat patients.
(中醫師常用草藥治療病人。)

precaution(n.)預防措施、防範
precautionary(adj.)預防的
take precautions 採取預防措施
safety precaution 安全防範措施
Take precautions against mosquito bites when you hike in summer.
(夏天健行時要做好防蚊措施。)
As a precaution, the school canceled all outdoor activities during the typhoon.
(為了預防起見，學校在颱風期間取消所有戶外活動。)

predator(n.)掠食者、捕食性動物
predatory(adj.)掠食性的、掠奪性的
natural predator 天敵
top predator 頂級掠食者
Sharks are top predators in the ocean food chain.
(鯊魚是海洋食物鏈中的頂級掠食者。)
The small fish hide among the rocks to escape from predators.
(小魚躲在岩石間逃避掠食者。)

preference(n.)偏好、喜好、優先
prefer(v.)較喜歡
preferable(adj.)更好的、較合意的
have a preference for 偏好……
personal preference 個人喜好
Choosing between tea and coffee is a matter of personal preference.
(選擇茶或咖啡純屬個人喜好。)
Many students have a preference for online learning.
(許多學生偏好線上學習。)

prejudice(n./v.)偏見、使有偏見
prejudiced(adj.)有偏見的
racial prejudice 種族偏見
prejudice against 對……的偏見
We should not have any prejudice against people from other cultures.
(我們不應對來自其他文化的人抱持任何偏見。)
The book helped me overcome my prejudice against science fiction.
(這本書幫助我克服了對科幻小說的偏見。)

preliminary(adj./n.)初步的、預備的、預賽
(無詞性變化)
preliminary round 預賽
preliminary results 初步結果
Our team made it through the preliminary round of the competition.
(我們隊通過了比賽的預賽。)
Preliminary results show that the new medicine is effective.
(初步結果顯示新藥有效。)

premature(adj.)過早的、早產的、不成熟的
prematurely(adv.)過早地
premature baby 早產兒
premature death 早逝
The premature baby had to stay in the hospital for two months.
(那名早產兒必須在醫院住兩個月。)
It is premature to say who will win the election.
(現在斷言誰會贏得選舉還言之過早。)

premier(adj./n.)首要的、最好的、首相、行政院長
premiere(n.)首映、首演
Premier League 英格蘭超級足球聯賽
the Premier 行政院長、總理
The Premier announced new measures to support small businesses.
(行政院長宣布支持小型企業的新措施。)
This hotel is one of the city's premier places to stay.
(這家飯店是這座城市最頂級的住宿地點之一。)

premise(n.)前提、(複數)房屋及土地
(無詞性變化)
on the premise that 在……的前提下
on the premises 在場地內
The plan is based on the premise that everyone will cooperate.
(這項計畫建立在每個人都會配合的前提上。)
Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the premises.
(場地內任何地方都禁止吸菸。)

premium(n.)保險費、額外費用、獎金
(無詞性變化)
insurance premium 保險費
at a premium 稀缺的、難得的
My parents pay a monthly insurance premium for our health insurance.
(我父母每月繳我們的健康保險費。)
During the holidays, hotel rooms near the beach are at a premium.
(假期期間，海邊附近的飯店房間一位難求。)

prescribe(v.)開(藥方)、規定
prescription(n.)處方、藥方
prescribe medicine 開藥
as prescribed 按照醫囑
The doctor prescribed some medicine for my sore throat.
(醫生開了一些藥治療我的喉嚨痛。)
Take the pills exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
(請完全按照醫生指示服藥。)

prescription(n.)處方、藥方、處方藥
prescribe(v.)開(藥方)
prescription drug 處方藥
fill a prescription 領藥、配藥
You need a prescription from a doctor to buy this medicine.
(你需要醫生開的處方才能買這種藥。)
I went to the pharmacy to fill my prescription.
(我去藥局領處方藥。)

Many important laws were passed during his presidency.

presidential(adj.)總統的、總統職位的
president(n.)總統

presidential candidate 總統候選人

presumably true 大概是真的

(班機延誤了，大概是因為濃霧。)
Presumably, the new library will open before the next semester.
(新圖書館大概會在下學期前開放。)

presume(v.)假定、推測、冒昧
presumably(adv.)大概
presumption(n.)假定、推測
presume that 推測……
be presumed dead 被推定死亡
I presume that you have already finished your homework.
(我猜你已經寫完作業了。)
The missing sailors were presumed dead after a month of searching.
(經過一個月的搜尋，失蹤的船員被推定死亡。)

prevail(v.)盛行、普遍、獲勝
prevailing(adj.)盛行的、普遍的
prevalent(adj.)流行的、普遍的
prevail over 戰勝
prevailing wind 盛行風
In the end, justice prevailed over evil.
(最後正義戰勝了邪惡。)
This custom still prevails in many rural villages.
(這項習俗在許多鄉村地區仍然盛行。)

prey on 捕食、欺騙

(許多長者成為電話詐騙的受害者。)

(那位歌手自稱為流行音樂之王。)

worker productivity 勞工生產力

(充足的睡眠能大幅提高你的效率。)

(新科技提升了許多工廠的生產力。)

profound knowledge 淵博的知識

(那位教授對中國古代史有淵博的知識。)

progressive(adj./n.)進步的、漸進的、改革派

progressive tense 進行式

(新市長以他對教育的進步思想聞名。)
The patient's condition showed progressive improvement over the week.
(病人的狀況在這週逐漸好轉。)

prohibit(v.)禁止、阻止

strictly prohibited 嚴格禁止
Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the school campus.

(根據人口推估，台灣未來的年輕人會越來越少。)

(老師把地圖投影在牆上。)

provoke a reaction 引起反應

(不要去挑釁那隻狗，否則牠可能會咬你。)

pulse rate 脈搏速率
